description: A figure loses its \caption, so a caption requirement must fail.

A FIGURE label is renamed, so that figure is no longer referenced anywhere.
comment: Anchored on \begin{figure} on purpose. Renaming any \label at random can land on a listing or a section heading, where 'this figure is never cited in the text' does not apply, and the mutant then measures nothing while looking like a miss.
